Ruth Patir's video installation "(M)otherland" was due to open on April 20 at Israel's national pavilion at the international art show, but the day before a media preview, she said it would remain closed for now. (Photo by GABRIEL BOUYS / AFP) (Photo by GABRIEL BOUYS/AFP via Getty Images)
